traits.fidelity: Real layout and rendering: screenshots, video and visual review are trustworthy evidence.
traits.footprint: Memory and process weight per session (parallelism headroom).
traits.authenticated_sessions: Can carry a signed-in state: persistent profiles, attach to a live browser, passkeys.

evidence: https://github.com/lightpanda-io/browser (upstream benchmark: ~9x faster, ~16x less memory than headless Chrome)

evidence.description: The run must leave visual evidence or reproduce what a person sees.

throughput.description: Read-mostly navigation and extraction where speed and parallelism matter.

authenticated.description: The flow depends on a signed-in state or passkeys.
